text: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program under which the company may repurchase up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A Ordinary Shares. This is similar in size to the prior $500 million program authorized in February 2024, and the new program does not have a fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.135][Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].

answer: In February 2026, Grab's board of directors authorized a new share repurchase program under which the company may repurchase up to **$500 million** worth of its outstanding Class A Ordinary Shares. This is similar in size to the prior $500 million program authorized in February 2024, and the new program does not have a fixed end date, does not obligate Grab to repurchase any specific amount, and may be suspended or terminated at any time [Grab, FY2025, p.135][Grab, FY2025, p.49, 50].
